summary.text: The information path is the Gu path specialized in agreements, intelligence gathering, and related Gu methods.

claims.text: The novel names information path as a cultivation path with Immortal Gu, attainment ranks, and grotto-heavens built around gathering clues, not as a casual word for news.

Information path specializes in agreements. The novel compares those agreements to locks that restrict both parties. Fairy Li Shan had cultivated earth path in the past, then cultivated information path mainly alongside wood path. She holds mountain pledge Immortal Gu, and Fang Yuan judges her information path attainment higher than his own. He treats her as a locksmith skilled at making locks and therefore skilled at opening them, and he often asks her for information path methods while trying to learn the path himself. With low information path attainment he makes little short-term progress, even while her letters and counsel clarify the fight between Zombie Alliance and Snowy Mountain blessed land.

Fairy Li Shan is an information path quasi-great grandmaster. Even while restricted by Snowy Mountain’s alliance agreement, she can skirt those restrictions to aid Blazing Heaven Demoness and suffer only mild injuries from the violation. After Old Ancestor Xue Hu expels her, Zombie Alliance welcomes her; her relationship with Blazing Heaven Demoness and her role in forcing Old Ancestor Xue Hu to give in earn her respect among the immortal zombies in Dark Flow Giant City.

In his previous life Fang Yuan had an organization and network, and his developed blood path Gu worm techniques could replace most information path methods. In this life he leans on previous-life memories together with intelligence mainly from people like Fairy Li Shan and Lang Ya land spirit. He concludes that he must use more information path methods to collect intelligence himself, relying on outsiders only for the short term.
Lacking Fairy Li Shan’s network while gathering intelligence on Chu Du, he names information path as one of his own weaknesses and resolves to fix it.

Profound Literature grotto-heaven is an information path grotto-heaven most specialized in gathering all kinds of information and clues, so its side expects to detect any invasion in advance. Old Immortal Hua Yu is its grotto-heaven owner. When Wu Shuai’s surprise invasion still arrives unseen, Hua Yu fights Dragon Palace with tides of recited characters and later pledges the grotto-heaven to Qi Sea Ancestor after the attack is driven off.

Information path is most specialized in gathering information, and Fang Yuan never had a notable accomplishment in it. He still makes progress: his foundation gathers information on ordinary Gu Immortals or super forces, yet his attainment in information path never catches up with his broader development.
